summary: 面向 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等编码 Agent 的确定性本地工作流运行时。
description: Deterministic, inspectable workflows for coding agents. Kilin is a local, CLI-first workflow runtime: describe a workflow in plain files, validate it before anything runs, then execute it through Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode with explicit approvals and persisted runs.
